description.narrative: The project has significant development impact, adding clean and affordable generation needed to help avert an imminent capacity shortage in an FCS market under extreme duress. At the market level, it will support improved competitiveness by replicating the long-term corporate power purchase agreement (PPA) structure established in GNG Wind Volyn (IFC disclosure project no. 48387), which is expected to generate further demonstration effects and deepen the corporate PPA market. In addition, the project is expected to enhance energy-system resilience by increasing the share of domestically produced renewable energy and diversifying the generation mix away from fossil fuels.

The proposed investment is the project financing of a 189 MW greenfield onshore wind power project in Ukraine (the Project). The project is undertaken by Volyn West Wind-2 LLC and Volyn West Wind-3 LLC, special purpose companies incorporated in Ukraine. The project will sell its generation under a corporate power purchase agreement. The Project is expected to be supported by partners of (i) the European Commission under the Ukraine Investment Framework (EC-UIF), and (ii) the Economic Resilience Action Program (ERA Program) for Ukraine including the Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation (NORAD), as described in the Blended Finance Section.
